seo.description_paragraph: The Greek name Philipp, which translates to 'friend of horses', has a rich cultural and religious history. In ancient Greece, the name was believed to be bestowed upon those who were protectors or helpers of horses. However, it gained significant religious value in the New Testament when Philip became one of the twelve apostles, known for his hospitality and evangelism. Despite its origins, the name remains popular today due to its unique meaning and association with strength, loyalty, and friendship.
